resources.string: Lets your paired JARVIS desktop assistant tap, swipe, and type on your behalf when you ask it to control an app on this phone. Only commands from your paired PC are accepted, and only after you approve pairing.
Enter the 6-digit code shown on your computer
JARVIS Mobile needs Accessibility permission to tap, swipe, and type on your behalf. This is optional — pairing, status, app-opening, volume, and navigation work without it.
